```python
import json
from collections import Counter

# Fields: size, origin, item type, material, smell
data = """
XL Iranian piano plastic garlic
S French knife steel lavender
XXS Portuguese book steel coconut
XXL Italian candle ceramic chocolate
XXL Brazilian hat glass leather
XXL Iranian box steel gasoline
XL Chinese marker steel vanilla
M British wallet plastic pine_needles
XXS Brazilian piano steel freshly_cut_grass
M Iranian bottle plastic chocolate
M Afghan box plastic citrus_fruits
XS Chinese bottle glass lavender
XS Chinese cup plastic chocolate
XXL Polish umbrella glass citrus_fruits
XXL Chinese ball steel freshly_cut_grass
L Spanish table ceramic garlic
XXL Canadian chair steel pine_needles
XXL Afghan lamp plastic pine_needles
XL German hat concrete pine_needles
M British pencil steel citrus_fruits
L Brazilian sunglasses steel baking_bread
M Brazilian bicycle plastic gasoline
XL British bottle plastic baking_bread
L Chinese calculator ceramic citrus_fruits
XS Iranian candle concrete garlic
XS Italian cup glass rose
XL Chinese hammer glass baking_bread
XS French apple steel garlic
XXL German bicycle concrete coffee
S Italian plate plastic rose
"""

color_groups = [
    ("black", 3), ("brown", 2), ("crimson", 2), ("gold", 1),
    ("gray", 2), ("green", 2), ("ivory", 3), ("khaki", 2),
    ("magenta", 1), ("orange", 1), ("purple", 1), ("red", 4),
    ("turquoise", 1), ("violet", 1), ("white", 2), ("yellow", 2),
]
colors = [color for color, count in color_groups for _ in range(count)]
fields = ("size", "origin", "type", "material", "smell")
initial = []
for line, color in zip(data.strip().splitlines(), colors):
    item = dict(zip(fields, line.split()))
    item["color"] = color
    initial.append(item)

assert len(initial) == len(colors) == 30

type_counts = Counter(item["type"] for item in initial)
retained = [
    item.copy() for item in initial
    if type_counts[item["type"]] % 2 == 1
]

after_mom = [item.copy() for item in retained]
for item in retained:
    if item["color"] == "red":
        copy = item.copy()
        copy.update(color="magenta", origin="Chinese", size="M",
                    smell="pine_needles", material="steel")
        after_mom.append(copy)

target_colors = Counter({
    "brown": 11, "gold": 1, "gray": 1, "green": 1, "ivory": 1,
    "khaki": 1, "magenta": 1, "red": 2, "white": 1, "yellow": 1,
})
target_materials = Counter({
    "steel": 10, "plastic": 7, "glass": 2, "ceramic": 2,
})

# All unlisted colors/materials are equivalent for these constraints.
color_candidates = sorted(set(colors) | {"OTHER_COLOR"})
material_candidates = sorted(
    {item["material"] for item in initial} | {"OTHER_MATERIAL"}
)
initial_pairs = {(item["smell"], item["color"]) for item in initial}

def qualifies(item):
    return (
        item["color"] != "magenta"
        and item["size"] != "XL"
        and item["material"] != "steel"
        and item["smell"] != "citrus_fruits"
        and item["origin"] != "Afghan"
    )

answers = set()
evidence = []

for favorite_color in color_candidates:
    after_sister = [item.copy() for item in after_mom]
    for item in after_sister:
        if item["material"] == "steel":
            item.update(color=favorite_color, smell="popcorn")
    if Counter(item["color"] for item in after_sister) != target_colors:
        continue

    for favorite_material in material_candidates:
        after_aunt = [item.copy() for item in after_sister]
        for item in after_aunt:
            if item["size"] == "XS":
                item.update(material=favorite_material, smell="lavender")
        if Counter(item["material"] for item in after_aunt) != target_materials:
            continue

        after_fiance = [item.copy() for item in after_aunt]
        for item in after_aunt:
            if (item["smell"], item["color"]) not in initial_pairs:
                after_fiance.append(item.copy())

        loss_indices = [
            index for index, item in enumerate(after_fiance)
            if item["size"] == "XL"
        ]
        if not loss_indices:
            continue

        counts = {
            sum(qualifies(item) for j, item in enumerate(after_fiance)
                if j != lost_index)
            for lost_index in loss_indices
        }
        answers.update(counts)
        evidence.append({
            "sister_color": favorite_color,
            "aunt_material": favorite_material,
            "retained": len(retained),
            "after_mom": len(after_mom),
            "fiance_copies": len(after_fiance) - len(after_aunt),
            "possible_extra_large_losses": len(loss_indices),
            "qualifying_counts": sorted(counts),
        })

if not answers:
    print("UNSUPPORTED")
else:
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": str(next(iter(answers))) if len(answers) == 1 else "unknown",
        "evidence": evidence,
    }, separators=(",", ":")))
```
